title: Zebrafish Embryos to Profile Nano(bio)materials for Toxicity Assays
author: Bragato, Lama, et al.
materials: Leica M205FA stereomicroscope with DFC450C digital camera
Malvern Zetasizer S90 for DLS/zeta potential

steps.title: Prepare nanoparticle working solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nanoparticle stock in Milli‑Q water to a concentration of 1 mg ml⁻¹, then dilute the stock in embryo solution (ES) or in 1× N‑phenylthiourea (PTU) prepared in ES to obtain the desired working concentration; PTU is used to inhibit melanophore and iridophore activity and keep embryos transparent during staining.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nanoparticles in Milli‑Q water to 1 mg ml⁻¹.
If pigment inhibition is needed, add PTU to ES to a final 1× concentration.
Dilute the 1 mg ml⁻¹ stock into ES or PTU‑ES to reach the experimental working concentration.
